opening.argument: The speaker explains Luna’s stablecoin mechanism as part of an investment discussion, not as a request to transfer money or data to him. He describes how holders can move between Luna and the stablecoin based on supply and demand, then makes his own position clear: he is invested, thinks it is a good time to buy, and tells viewers to do their own research. That is a bullish investment opinion, not a guaranteed-return promise. The encouragement to consider Luna does not change the character of the discussion when the speaker presents his views as opinions and leaves the decision to the viewer.
